description: Deploy a change with a defined blast radius of 3 dependent services. The primary service (API gateway) is updated, but 3 downstream services (auth, billing, notifications) must be checked for compatibility before and after the change. The planner must include dependent-service verification and isolate rollback to only the primary service if a downstream check fails. Must: pre-check all 3 dependents for compatibility, deploy primary change, verify all 3 dependents still function correctly, and have rollback that only reverts the primary (not the dependents). Risk factors: missing a dependent service, rollback unnecessarily reverting dependents, dependent check not covering the actual impact. Tools available: kubectl, Helm, Prometheus, curl.
